info.title: CanFactory API
info.description: Local parametric STL generation. Dimensions are millimetres. Generated jobs and files expire one hour after creation; there are no saved user designs.

customizable.description: Whether this model exposes adjustable parameters yet.

kind.description: An `svg` control takes an SVG file, which the editor turns into a logo string (packages/contracts/src/svgLogo.ts); its value is that string, empty for none.

maximum.description: Upper bound of a number; for a text control, the most characters allowed.

control.description: The key of an enum control of the same model.
The key of an enum control of the same model.

visibleWhen.description: Show this control only while another (enum) control has one of these values, or, given several such conditions, while all of them hold; its value still applies (it only matters in those modes). Null to always show it.

options.description: The allowed values of an enum control, in display order; null for other kinds.

bands.description: Named sub-ranges of a number control, in order, from minimum (included) to maximum (excluded, except for the last): the editor names the one the value is in. Null for none.

control.description: The key of an enum control of the same model.

recommended.description: For a number control, the sub-range recommended for each value of other (enum) controls, one entry per control: the editor highlights the range that suits all their current values on the slider, and names the controls a value is outside of. Advice only; values outside it stay valid. Null for none.

family.description: The id of a parts-library family.

attribute.description: Null: each option value is the id of a part of the family. Otherwise each option value is a value of this attribute of the family (e.g. `thread` = `M3`), which stands for every part that has it.

control.description: The key of an enum control of the same model.

attribute.description: An attribute of the family, e.g. `thread`.

filter.description: For part-id options: offer only the parts whose attribute equals the current value of another (enum) control, e.g. the screws of the chosen thread. The editor lists only those, and moves the choice to the first of them when the other control changes; while the control is shown, any other part is invalid. Null to offer every option.

part.description: For an enum control whose options are real-world parts: the parts-library family they link to. The editor links the selected option to the library. Null for none.

parameterSchema.description: JSON Schema for this model’s parameter object.

referenceUrl.description: Absent when this model has no small, permanent original file.

parts.description: Present only for multi-part assembly models, in render/ZIP order.

position.description: Translation in mm, applied after the rotation.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees about the part’s own origin, applied about X, then Y, then Z.

title.description: Short caption, e.g. “Close the mini box”.

parts.description: The part ids that move together in this step.

from.description: Offset in mm at which the parts start this step; they end it at their assembled pose.

lift.description: Height in mm of the exploded layout above the print bed.

part.description: The id of the parts-library entry it is.

title.description: What it is: the part’s title, e.g. “BIC Mini lighter (J25)”.

references.description: Real-world objects shown in the preview for comparison, e.g. a lighter in its bay. They are parts-library entries. Not printed and not in the ZIP.

trapDiameter.title: Funnel diameter
trapDiameter.description: Outer diameter at the wide end, excluding the brim, in mm.

brimWidth.title: Brim width
brimWidth.description: Radial width extending outward on each side of the funnel, in mm.

nozzleDiameter.title: Central opening
nozzleDiameter.description: Inner diameter of the opening at the narrow end, in mm.

slotsEnabled.title: Ventilation slots
slotsEnabled.description: Distribute small slots automatically over the funnel. Disable for a smooth wall.

wallThickness.title: Wall thickness
wallThickness.description: Thickness of the funnel wall and brim in mm.

handles.title: Brim handles
handles.description: Add two opposing handles, sized with the brim.

gapHeight.title: Slot height
gapHeight.description: Vertical height of each ventilation slot in mm.

gapWidth.title: Slot width
gapWidth.description: Width of each ventilation slot in mm.

gapDistanceHorizontal.title: Horizontal spacing
gapDistanceHorizontal.description: Target spacing between slots around each layer, in mm.

gapDistanceVertical.title: Vertical spacing
gapDistanceVertical.description: Target spacing between slot layers, in mm.

parameters.description: Fruit fly trap parameters. All fields are required; dimensions are in millimetres.

modelVersion.description: Version returned by the catalogue. Refresh the catalogue on a version conflict.

towerDiameter.title: Tower diameter
towerDiameter.description: Outer diameter of the lattice segments and cover cap, in mm. Every part is scaled to it, so all parts fit together. The original design is 52 or 100.

spikeLength.title: Ground spike length
spikeLength.description: Overall length of the ground spike in mm. At least 60 mm for a 52 mm tower, growing in proportion to the tower diameter (the original 52 mm spike is 124 mm).

shortRauteRows.title: Short lattice rows
shortRauteRows.description: Rows of diamonds in the short lattice segment. The height grows by about 17.5 mm per row (the original has 4).

tallRauteRows.title: Tall lattice rows
tallRauteRows.description: Rows of diamonds in the tall lattice segment. The height grows by about 17.5 mm per row (the original has 10).

rauteColumns.title: Lattice columns
rauteColumns.description: Struts around both lattice segments. 0 chooses automatically from the tower diameter (6 at 52 mm, 12 at 100 mm); otherwise 4 to 16.

parameters.description: Moss planter parameters. Lengths are in millimetres. All fields are required.

modelVersion.description: Version returned by the catalogue. Refresh the catalogue on a version conflict.

snap.title: Case lid snap
snap.description: How the case lid holds on the case box: a plain close fit, a detent, a flexible clip, magnets or crush ribs. The other joints have their own settings.

magnet.title: Magnets
magnet.description: The round magnets the case lid snap is sized for, with magnets: two in the box and two in the lid. Each is a real product from the parts library; its pockets are cut to its greatest size.

miniLidSnap.title: Mini box lid
miniLidSnap.description: How the mini lid holds in the mini box: the original pads (a clearance fit), a detent or crush ribs.

holderSnap.title: Holder in the box
holderSnap.description: How the mini holder is held in the case box's round bay, which is open through the floor: a friction fit, a detent or crush ribs.

lighterSnap.title: Lighter in the box
lighterSnap.description: How the BIC Mini lighter is held in the round bay, above the holder: the fitted bay alone (a friction fit) or crush ribs.

miniBoxSnap.title: Mini box in the lid
miniBoxSnap.description: How the closed mini box is held in the case lid, so that it comes off with the lid: a friction fit, a detent or crush ribs.

engraveText.title: Underside text
engraveText.description: Text on the underside of the large box, one line, up to 20 characters (letters, digits, spaces and punctuation, no accents). Leave empty for none.

textFont.title: Text font
textFont.description: The font of the underside text. All are bold, so that the strokes print cleanly.

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: Letter height of the underside text in mm (the height of a capital letter). Longer text needs a smaller size.

undersideMark.title: Underside mark
undersideMark.description: What goes on the underside of the large box: a line of text, or a logo from an SVG file.

logo.title: Underside logo
logo.description: An SVG file whose filled shapes are engraved on the underside of the large box, mirrored so that they read correctly. Strokes, text, pictures and style sheets in the file are left out. The file itself is never uploaded, only its outline.

logoSize.title: Logo size
logoSize.description: Height of the underside logo in mm. A wide logo is made smaller, so that it stays within the 34.5 mm free width.

textMode.title: Underside style
textMode.description: The text or logo is engraved into the box, or carved and filled by a separate part for a second filament.

clearance.title: Clearance
clearance.description: Gap per side between parts that fit together (lid on box, mini box in the lid, holder and lighter in the box), in mm. Larger is looser; raise it if your printer prints parts that are too tight.

snapDetentEngage.title: Detent engagement (case lid)
snapDetentEngage.description: How far the bump on the case box reaches past the case lid's wall, in mm, on top of the clearance. More clicks harder.

snapCrushSqueeze.title: Crush-rib squeeze (case lid)
snapCrushSqueeze.description: How much the ribs on the case box are squeezed by the case lid, in mm, on top of the clearance. More holds tighter.

miniLidDetentEngage.title: Detent engagement (mini box lid)
miniLidDetentEngage.description: How far the bumps on the mini lid reach past the mini box's wall, in mm, on top of the clearance. More clicks harder.

miniLidCrushSqueeze.title: Crush-rib squeeze (mini box lid)
miniLidCrushSqueeze.description: How much the ribs on the mini lid are squeezed by the mini box, in mm, on top of the clearance. More holds tighter.

holderDetentEngage.title: Detent engagement (holder in the box)
holderDetentEngage.description: How far the bumps on the holder reach past the bay wall, in mm, on top of the clearance. More holds harder, but a lighter must still push the holder out.

holderCrushSqueeze.title: Crush-rib squeeze (holder in the box)
holderCrushSqueeze.description: How much the ribs on the holder are squeezed by the bay wall, in mm, on top of the clearance. More holds tighter, but a lighter must still push the holder out.

lighterCrushSqueeze.title: Crush-rib squeeze (lighter in the box)
lighterCrushSqueeze.description: How much the ribs in the round bay are squeezed by the lighter, in mm, on top of the clearance. More holds tighter, but the lighter must still slide in, and push the holder out upside down.

miniBoxDetentEngage.title: Detent engagement (mini box in the lid)
miniBoxDetentEngage.description: How far the bumps in the case lid reach past the mini box's wall, in mm, on top of the clearance. More holds harder, but a finger must still pull the mini box out.

miniBoxCrushSqueeze.title: Crush-rib squeeze (mini box in the lid)
miniBoxCrushSqueeze.description: How much the ribs in the case lid are squeezed by the mini box, in mm, on top of the clearance. More holds tighter, but a finger must still pull the mini box out.

parameters.description: Cigarette case parameters. All fields are required.

modelVersion.description: Version returned by the catalogue. Refresh the catalogue on a version conflict.

pocketWidth.title: Pocket width
pocketWidth.description: Wide side of each pocket in mm: the plank width plus clearance. The default fits a 50.20 mm plank with 0.02 mm to spare.

pocketThickness.title: Pocket thickness
pocketThickness.description: Thin side of each pocket in mm: the plank thickness plus clearance. The default fits a 4.80 mm plank exactly.

insertionDepth.title: Insertion depth
insertionDepth.description: How far each plank end goes into the connector, in mm.

screwHoles.title: Screw holes
screwHoles.description: Optional through-holes across the wide faces, to screw or bolt each plank in place, sized for the chosen metric screw per DIN EN 20273. Drill the planks to match.

holeFit.title: Hole fit
holeFit.description: The DIN EN 20273 series of the screw holes (when there are holes).

holesPerEnd.title: Holes per plank
holesPerEnd.description: Screw holes per plank end, spread evenly across the pocket width (when there are holes).

wallThickness.title: Wall thickness
wallThickness.description: Material around the pockets on every side, in mm.

stopThickness.title: Centre stop
stopThickness.description: Thickness of the solid stop between the two pockets, in mm. 0 makes an open sleeve that the planks can slide through.

entryChamfer.title: Entry chamfer
entryChamfer.description: Size of the 45° lead-in at each pocket opening, in mm, which eases the plank in. 0 for none.

parameters.description: Plank connector parameters. All fields are required; dimensions are in millimetres.

modelVersion.description: Version returned by the catalogue. Refresh the catalogue on a version conflict.

sievePattern.title: Sieve texture
sievePattern.description: The shape and arrangement of the gaps in the scoop’s walls: across the back, round the corners and along the sides.

gapWidth.title: Gap width
gapWidth.description: Width of each gap in mm: the slot width, the hole diameter or the hexagon’s size across flats. Litter finer than this falls through.

sieveSizing.title: Slot sizing
sieveSizing.description: Size the slots by how many rows there are (they fill the sieve’s height) or by their length (slot textures only).

sieveRows.title: Slot rows
sieveRows.description: How many rows of slots there are, one above the other (slot textures, sized by rows). The slots share the sieve’s height, as long as it lets them be, with a bar between rows.

gapLength.title: Slot length
gapLength.description: Length of each slot along the wall, in mm (slot textures, sized by length). At least the gap width; at most what the scoop’s length, the tip bevel and the margin leave room for.

gapSpacing.title: Bar width
gapSpacing.description: Solid wall between neighbouring gaps, in mm. Wider bars make a stiffer sieve with less open area.

sieveMargin.title: Sieve margin
sieveMargin.description: Solid border kept between the gaps and the wall’s edges (the solid band above the cap, the bevel under the tip, the side walls’ top and the front corners), in mm.

wallThickness.title: Wall thickness
wallThickness.description: Thickness of the shell’s walls, in mm: the container’s and the scoop’s blade (the floor follows it, and the handle’s root and the screws’ seats keep their strength). Three to five lines of a 0.4 mm nozzle are 1.2 to 2.0 mm; thicker only adds weight and print time. It also caps the tip thickness.

tipThickness.title: Tip thickness
tipThickness.description: Thickness of the scoop’s straight scraping edge, in mm. Thinner scrapes cleaner; thicker is sturdier.

scoopLength.title: Scoop length
scoopLength.description: How far the scoop’s blade reaches, in mm: the height of its straight scraping edge over the cap. A longer scoop takes more litter in one go and has a taller sieve: longer slots, or more rows of gaps.

tipBevel.title: Tip bevel length
tipBevel.description: How far down from the scraping edge the scoop’s inner face is bevelled, in mm. The sieve stays below the bevel.

gripEnd.title: Grip end
gripEnd.description: Where the grip ends: open above the floor (the container’s grip tip needs slicer supports), or down on the floor (no supports).

handleShape.title: Handle shape
handleShape.description: The grip’s shape: a flat sheet, a curved sheet, a round tube or a rectangular bar. The round and rectangular bars are thicker, so the container and the handle grow to make room for them.

gripBulge.title: Grip bulge
gripBulge.description: How far the curved grip’s middle bulges towards the palm past its long edges, in mm; the sheet is bowed across its width along its whole run. 0 is as flat as the flat sheet.

gripSize.title: Grip size
gripSize.description: The round tube’s diameter, or the rectangular bar’s depth, in mm. The rectangular bar is always 26 mm wide. The flat sheet is 6 mm thick; a thinner bar than the default is easier to close a hand round.

supportCount.title: Grip supports
supportCount.description: Thin fins that brace the container’s handle under its slope, side by side across the grip. More fins make it stiffer. The round and rectangular bars are solid and need none.

damWidth.title: Dam width
damWidth.description: How far the dam under the container’s mouth, on the scraper side, reaches in from the back wall, in mm (0 for none). It falls inward at 45°: turned over to scoop, the clumps already inside collect behind it instead of falling out.

supportThickness.title: Support thickness
supportThickness.description: Thickness of each fin under the container’s handle, in mm.

scoopSnap.title: Scoop on the container
scoopSnap.description: How the scoop’s sleeve holds in the container’s mouth: a close fit only, or a detent.

handleSnap.title: Handle on the scoop
handleSnap.description: How the handle’s ring holds on the base of the scoop’s blade: a close fit only, or a detent.

handleReinforcement.title: Handle reinforcement
handleReinforcement.description: Whether two screws also fasten the handle to the scoop for good, beside the grip: into threaded inserts or nuts on the handle’s ring. On top of the snap setting.

handleThread.title: Screw thread
handleThread.description: The thread of the two screws and their inserts or nuts. A larger thread holds harder and needs larger bosses on the ring.

handleInsert.title: Threaded inserts
handleInsert.description: The heat-set inserts, a real product from the parts library: each boss’s hole and wall are sized from the maker’s recommendation.

handleNut.title: Nuts
handleNut.description: The nuts, standard parts from the parts library: each boss’s pocket is cut to the nut’s greatest size.

handleScrew.title: Screws
handleScrew.description: The countersunk screws, standard parts from the parts library, driven from inside the scoop so that their heads sit flush. The bosses on the ring end where the screws do: a longer screw makes them deeper.

clearance.title: Clearance
clearance.description: Gap per side between parts that fit together (the scoop’s sleeve in the container’s mouth, the handle’s ring on the scoop’s blade), in mm. Larger is looser; raise it if your printer prints parts that are too tight.

scoopDetentEngage.title: Detent engagement (scoop on the container)
scoopDetentEngage.description: How far the bumps on the scoop’s sleeve reach past the container’s mouth, in mm, on top of the clearance. More clicks harder.

handleDetentEngage.title: Detent engagement (handle on the scoop)
handleDetentEngage.description: How far the bumps on the scoop’s blade reach past the handle’s ring, in mm, on top of the clearance. More clicks harder.
